identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Tivantinib in Subjects With Inoperable Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) Who Have Been Treated With One Prior Therapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind Study of Tivantinib (ARQ 197) in Subjects With MET Diagnostic-High Inoperable Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treated With One Prior Systemic Therapy

armGroups.label: Tivantinib 240 mg BID Cohort
armGroups.description: The tivantinib dosage of 240 mg tablets administered by mouth twice daily (BID), once in the morning and once in the evening, with food, for a total daily dose of 480 mg.

armGroups.label: Tivantinib 120 mg BID Cohort
armGroups.description: Tivantinib 120 mg is administered by oral tablet BID, once in the morning and once in the evening, with food, for a total daily dose of 240 mg (amended dosing group; primary analysis group).

armGroups.label: Placebo Matching 240 mg BID Cohort
armGroups.description: Matching placebo is administered by oral tablet(s) BID, once in the morning and once in the evening, with food.

armGroups.label: Placebo Matching 120 mg BID Cohort
armGroups.description: Matching placebo is administered by oral tablet(s) BID, once in the morning and once in the evening, with food.
